desc: Build adjacency list from edges and set up iterative DFS state carrying node, parent, depth, root distance, and inherited cur_start.
Implement rollback sliding window: maintain path_dist indexed by depth, last-occurrence array per value, compute new start = max(parent_ns, last[x]+1), set last[x]=dep, and restore on exit.
At each node compute length = d - path_dist[ns] and node count = dep-ns+1, updating global best with length-max then count-min tie-breaking.
Ensure rollback correctness across branching subtrees (restore last[x] via exit frames) and cleanly handle first-time values.
Verify edge cases: single-node paths (best initialized to [0,1]), repeated values along a chain (Example 2 -> [0,1]), and both provided examples (Example 1 -> [6,2]).
Confirmed running-max constraint is monotonic and last[x]+1<=ns handles already-excluded duplicates without extra checks; path_dist remains valid for current path.
